from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import time

root = Path.home() / ".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
runtime = root / "models"

retry_at = 0.0
if db_path.is_file() and not db_path.is_symlink():
